```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

training_data <- readRDS("training_data.rds")

predictors <- c(
  "HomeAway", "TeamRankCategory", "OpponentRankCategory",
  "Round", "OpponentRound", "RestAdvantage",
  "DWF", "DLF", "DDF",
  "attack_score", "defence_score",
  "opp_attack_score", "opp_defence_score",
  "DRF", "DYF", "DFF", "DCS", "DSTF", "DSF"
)
# Keep the same observations for all candidate models
model_data <- training_data %>%
  select(Goals, all_of(predictors)) %>%
  na.omit()

null_model <- glm(
  Goals ~ 1,
  data = model_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

full_model <- glm(
  reformulate(predictors, response = "Goals"),
  data = model_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

both_model <- step(
  null_model,
  scope = list(
    lower = formula(null_model),
    upper = formula(full_model)
  ),
  direction = "both",
  trace = 0
)
```

```{r}
formula(both_model)
```
